title: Meguro K3 Vintage (Classic Heritage)
description: Representing Kawasaki's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Kawasaki Meguro K3 Vintage (Classic Heritage) is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
